species.real: The Ascension Island parsley fern was declared extinct in 2003, then in 2009 botanists found a few plants clinging to a cliff on Green Mountain, and Kew has grown it on since.
species.name: Mistfrond

dex.text: A bundle of bamboo and tree fern that has put itself in charge of the cloud. It was planted here on purpose, and so was everything else on the mountain, which makes it the only local with paperwork.
dex.fact: Much of the green forest on Green Mountain was planted from the 1840s, on the advice of Joseph Hooker of Kew and Charles Darwin, to make rain by trapping cloud on a bare volcanic peak.
